entities.name: Registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE for initial registration, mobility registration update, or periodic registration update.

entities.name: Registration Attempt Counter
entities.description: Counter used to limit the number of subsequently rejected registration attempts. Incremented during registration rejection and reset under specific conditions.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State where UE has initiated registration procedure but not yet completed it.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
entities.description: Substate where UE is attempting registration while in deregistered state.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE
entities.description: Substate where UE is attempting registration update while in registered state.

entities.name: Timer T3519
entities.description: Timer stopped when registration attempt counter is reset.

entities.name: Timer T3502
entities.description: Timer whose expiration triggers reset of registration attempt counter.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer whose start triggers reset of registration attempt counter.

entities.name: SUCI
entities.description: Subscription Concealed Identifier, deleted when registration attempt counter is reset.

entities.name: Access Restriction Condition
entities.description: Condition preventing UE from initiating registration over one access when in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state over the other access.

entities.name: Counter Reset Condition
entities.description: Various conditions that trigger reset of registration attempt counter.

relations.description: Registration procedure uses registration attempt counter to track failed attempts.
Access restriction condition applies when UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Counter reset conditions trigger reset of registration attempt counter.
Counter reset condition stops timer T3519 if running.
Counter reset condition causes deletion of stored SUCI.
Counter reset conditions apply when UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION state.
Counter reset conditions apply when UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state.
Expiration of timer T3502 establishes counter reset condition.
Start of timer T3346 establishes counter reset condition.
